_readme: D2: held-out scenarios outside the Display-heavy official kit (Battery, Display, Performance, Camera). Reference texts were written by the team in the style of the kit's SIIS articles (not copied from any vendor page). Gold deeplink ids come from starter_kit/Theme 2/deeplinks.json. Two cases pair a complaint with an unrelated article and must abstain. Written 28 Sep 2026; never used for tuning.

cases.query: My Nexa X1 battery drains really fast since the last software update, it barely lasts half a day.

siis_response.title: Battery drains quickly on smartphone or tablet
siis_response.content:
## Step 1: Turn on Power saving
Power saving limits background activity and lowers performance slightly to extend battery life. To turn it on, go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap the switch next to Power saving.
## Step 2: Put unused apps to sleep
Apps you rarely use can keep running in the background and drain the battery. Go to Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, and then tap the switch next to Put unused apps to sleep.
## Step 3: Restart your device
After a software update, a restart can finish pending optimisation. Press and hold the Side button, then tap Restart. Tap Restart again to confirm.
## Step 4: Contact Customer Support
If the battery still drains quickly, contact Customer Support to have the battery checked.

expected_actions.name: Enable Put Unused Apps to Sleep

cases.query: phone takes forever to charge now, like 4 hours with the original charger

siis_response.title: Smartphone charges slowly
siis_response.content:
## Check the charger and cable
Inspect the charger and USB cable for damage and try a different original charger and cable. Remove any case that may block the charging port, and gently clean the port with a dry soft brush.
## Turn on Fast charging
Fast charging only works when it is turned on. Go to Settings, tap Battery, tap Charging settings, and then tap the switch next to Fast charging.
## Avoid using the phone while charging
Using demanding apps while charging generates heat and slows charging. Close games and video apps while the phone charges.

expected_actions.name: Avoid Using the Phone While Charging

cases.query: How do I stop my tablet from charging to 100% every night? I want to protect the battery.

siis_response.title: Protect your battery on smartphone or tablet
siis_response.content:
## Use Battery protection
Keeping the battery at 100% for long periods can shorten its lifespan. Battery protection stops charging at a lower level. Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap the switch next to Battery protection.
## Charge in a cool place
Avoid charging the device in direct sunlight or under a pillow, because heat reduces battery lifespan.

cases.query: my eyes hurt when i use my phone at night, the screen feels too harsh and blue

siis_response.title: Reduce eye strain on your smartphone
siis_response.content:
## Turn on Eye comfort shield
Eye comfort shield reduces blue light to make the screen easier on your eyes at night. Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap the switch next to Eye comfort shield.
## Lower the brightness
Swipe down from the top of the screen to open the Quick settings panel, and then drag the brightness slider to the left.
## Take regular breaks
Look away from the screen for 20 seconds every 20 minutes.

cases.query: Scrolling on my Nexa X1 looks choppy and not smooth at all.

siis_response.title: Screen does not look smooth when scrolling
siis_response.content:
## Adjust Motion smoothness
A higher refresh rate makes scrolling and animations look smoother. Go to Settings, tap Display, tap Motion smoothness, and then select Adaptive.
## Turn off Power saving
Power saving can limit the refresh rate. Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap the switch next to Power saving to turn it off.

cases.query: the screen switches off way too quickly while i'm reading

siis_response.title: Screen turns off too quickly
siis_response.content:
## Change Screen timeout
The screen turns off after a set period of inactivity. Go to Settings, tap Display, tap Screen timeout, and then choose a longer duration.
## Check Power saving
Power saving may shorten the screen timeout. Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap the switch next to Power saving to turn it off.

cases.query: My phone has become really slow and laggy, apps take ages to open.

siis_response.title: Smartphone is slow or lagging
siis_response.content:
## Optimise your device
Device care can close background apps and free up memory in one tap. Go to Settings, tap Device care, and then tap Optimize now.
## Put unused apps to sleep
Go to Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, and then tap the switch next to Put unused apps to sleep.
## Restart your device
Press and hold the Side button, then tap Restart. Tap Restart again to confirm.
## Free up storage
Delete files and apps you no longer need, because a nearly full storage slows the device down.

expected_actions.name: Enable Put Unused Apps to Sleep

cases.query: Can my phone restart itself automatically at night so it stays fast?

siis_response.title: Schedule automatic restarts
siis_response.content:
## Turn on Restart on schedule
Restarting regularly keeps the device running smoothly. Go to Settings, tap Device care, tap Auto optimization, and then tap Restart on schedule. Choose the days and time for the restart.

cases.query: my phone gets extremely hot when i play games for a while

siis_response.title: Smartphone overheats while gaming
siis_response.content:
## Remove the case
A thick case traps heat. Remove the case while playing games.
## Change the Performance profile
A lighter performance profile reduces heat. Go to Settings, tap Device care, tap Performance profile, and then select Light.
## Close background apps
Tap the Recents button and then tap Close all to stop apps running in the background.
## Let the device cool down
If the device is very hot, stop using it and let it cool down before charging it.

cases.query: The camera app shows a black screen and says the camera is blocked in other apps too.

siis_response.title: Camera is blocked or cannot be opened
siis_response.content:
## Allow camera access
If camera access is turned off in privacy settings, apps cannot use the camera. Go to Settings, tap Security and privacy, tap Privacy, and then tap the switch next to Camera access.
## Restart your device
Press and hold the Side button, then tap Restart. Tap Restart again to confirm.
## Contact Customer Support
If the camera still does not work, contact Customer Support to have the camera module checked.
